options.name: boot_time_command
options.description: Command to run that returns a unique string indicating the last time the system was booted. Setting this to a command that has different output each time it is run will cause the task to fail.

options.name: connect_timeout
options.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a successful connection to the managed hosts before trying again. If unspecified, the default setting for the underlying connection plugin is used.

options.name: msg
options.description: Message to display to users before reboot.

options.name: post_reboot_delay
options.description: Seconds to wait after the reboot command was successful before attempting to validate the system rebooted successfully. This is useful if you want wait for something to settle despite your connection already working.

options.name: pre_reboot_delay
options.description: Seconds to wait before reboot. Passed as a parameter to the reboot command. On Linux, macOS and OpenBSD, this is converted to minutes and rounded down. If less than 60, it will be set to 0. On Solaris and FreeBSD, this will be seconds.

options.name: reboot_command
options.description: Command to run that reboots the system, including any parameters passed to the command. Can be an absolute path to the command or just the command name. If an absolute path to the command is not given, O(search_paths) on the target system will be searched to find the absolute path. This will cause O(pre_reboot_delay), O(post_reboot_delay), and O(msg) to be ignored.

options.name: reboot_timeout
options.description: Maximum seconds to wait for machine to reboot and respond to a test command. This timeout is evaluated separately for both reboot verification and test command success so the maximum execution time for the module is twice this amount.

options.name: search_paths
options.description: Paths to search on the remote machine for the C(shutdown) command. I(Only) these paths will be searched for the C(shutdown) command. E(PATH) is ignored in the remote node when searching for the C(shutdown) command.

options.name: test_command
options.description: Command to run on the rebooted host and expect success from to determine the machine is ready for further tasks.
